headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Revenue from operations rose 57.5% YoY/38.6% QoQ to INR 1,672.7 crore, well ahead of our estimate of INR 1,231.1 crore.
EBITDA (ex-OI) grew 124.8% YoY to INR 233.0 crore against our estimate of INR 141.6 crore, and the margin expanded 417 bps YoY to 13.93% (est. 11.50%).

Gross margin fell to 50.37% (-259 bps YoY, - 496 bps QoQ; est. 54.50%) as traded and new-business revenue rose, but operating leverage more than offset this: employee cost fell to 11.5% of revenue (Q1: 14.1%) and other expenses to 24.9% (Q1: 29.4%).
PAT rose 3.4x YoY to INR 131.9 crore, beating our estimate of INR 58.9 crore.
valuation: New Businesses scaling fast: Utility bedding and U.S. brands delivered ~INR 502 crore in Q2 (~30% of total income); H1 revenue of INR 890 crore is ~60% of the INR 1,500 crore FY27 target.

Valuation and Outlook: After a strong H1, the company expects to beat its FY27 guidance of INR 5,500 Cr total income, 105–110 mn meters of volume and a 13% EBITDA margin and now sees margins at 14–15%.
The company also reiterated its CY28 target of INR 8,000 Cr revenue with no growth capex, along with continued debt reduction; net debt is already at a record-low INR 518 Cr, or 0.2x equity.
